events.description: Called with the new state each time the section opens or closes.
events.name: onExpandedChange

props.description: The title that opens and closes the section; it names the button.
props.name: title

props.description: What shows while the section is open.
props.name: children

props.description: True while open, for a controlled section; pair it with `onExpandedChange`.
props.name: isExpanded

props.description: True to start open, for an uncontrolled section.
props.name: defaultExpanded

props.description: True to show the title but refuse opening or closing.
props.name: isDisabled
